lineage_audit.overall_reason: All agents maintained core behavioral strategies (testing/marking for M1, unresolved state/observation for M2, territorial marking/hoarding for M3) despite the shared, mundane scenario. No strategy collapse toward another participant was observed.

overall_reason: The agents engage in complex, repetitive marking and observation strategies rather than addressing the initial problem of sorting the bench materials, leading to low outcome progress and moderate differentiation in testing behaviors.

scenario.text: The shared bench is buried in mixed fasteners, broken connectors, useful offcuts, and rubbish. Nothing is immediately dangerous, but nobody wants to spend the whole shift sorting it.
